name: 陳世剛
objective:
微處理器為各類高效能電子產品中的核心關鍵元件，其相關技術對電機與電子工程領域的工程師而言已愈發重要。本課程旨在系統性介紹近代微處理器的發展脈絡與基礎原理，內容涵蓋微處理器架構、軟體開發環境、C 語言程式設計，以及周邊電路之設計與應用。課程將以 TI（Texas Instruments）微處理器為教學範例，透過整合性的方式說明微處理器的通用運作原理與設計概念。修課學生完成本課程後，將能舉一反三，將所學原理應用至其他類型的微處理器或嵌入式系統之開發與設計。

Microprocessors are one of the core components in a wide range of high-performance electronic products, and microprocessor technologies have become increasingly important for electrical and electronic engineers. This course aims to provide a systematic introduction to modern microprocessors, covering their historical development and fundamental principles. The course content includes microprocessor architectures, software development environments, C language programming, and peripheral circuit design. Texas Instruments (TI) microprocessors are used as representative examples throughout the course. Through an integrated instructional approach, the general operating principles and design concepts of microprocessors are introduced. Upon completion of this course, students will be able to apply the acquired knowledge and principles to other types of microprocessors or embedded processing systems.
